comment: Source ZIP bundles built by scripts/build-bundles.sh and published by .github/workflows/bundles.yml. 'members' are the Cargo workspace members kept in the bundle ('.' is the core); 'all' keeps the whole workspace. 'standalone' ships one crate on its own. 'smoke' is what scripts/smoke-bundle.* checks after installing: 'run' = clibm plugin run, 'version' = <binary> --version, 'installed' = binary present.

bundles.name: clibm-core
bundles.title: Core CLI only
bundles.description: The clibm CLI and the clibm_core library, with no plugins.

bundles.name: clibm-workspace
bundles.title: Core + all official plugins
bundles.description: The full Cargo workspace: core, every official plugin, the plugin template and the test suite.

bundles.name: clibm-dep-audit
bundles.title: Core + clibm-dep-audit
bundles.description: DAG critical path and circular dependency auditor, with the core it builds against.

bundles.name: clibm-export-md
bundles.title: Core + clibm-export-md
bundles.description: Markdown sprint report exporter, with the core it builds against.

bundles.name: clibm-workflow-lint
bundles.title: Core + clibm-workflow-lint
bundles.description: Kanban WIP limit and workflow policy linter, with the core it builds against.

bundles.name: clibm-tui
bundles.title: Core + clibm-tui
bundles.description: Terminal user interface, with the core it builds against.

bundles.name: clibm-web
bundles.title: Core + clibm-web
bundles.description: Local web UI served by a single binary, with the core it builds against.

bundles.name: clibm-plugin-template
bundles.title: Core + plugin template
bundles.description: Starter crate for new plugins, with the core its integration tests use.

bundles.name: clibm-mcp
bundles.title: clibm-mcp (standalone)
bundles.description: MCP server for AI agents (stdio / HTTP). It talks to the clibm CLI, so it builds on its own.
